reuse.why: Puts the decision in the existing ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard used by all providers, but copies unlinkAccount's field-clearing update instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount block from unlinkAccount is copied verbatim into ensureAccountIsNotLinked, so 'what an unlinked account looks like' now lives in two places.

placement.why: Logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the link guard, but a mutation is placed inside a function named ensureAccountIsNotLinked, which was a pure check.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the flag, the guard and its six provider callers plus one test, with a couple of long unformatted call lines.

maintainability.why: The flag has to be forwarded through six provider functions and the unlink state is duplicated, so a future change to unlinking can drift between the two paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts ensureAccountIsNotLinked re-implements the unlink field reset instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount.
